title: gemini-3-flash-preview hallucinates unrelated image content in Gemini CLI after reading correct clipboard PNG

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes model hallucination and output quality behavior with gemini-3-flash-preview when processing image input. The reporter confirms that Gemini CLI successfully captured and transmitted the image as inlineData, and other models like gemini-2.5-pro function as expected. As this is a high-level complaint regarding LLM model output quality rather than a systemic code defect in the Gemini CLI codebase, it is classified as NEEDS_INFO.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug... The issue appears to describe a model hallucination behavior with gemini-3-flash-preview rather than a bug in Gemini CLI's codebase, as the CLI successfully captured and attached the image data as inlineData. If you suspect a specific code defect in how Gemini CLI constructs requests or handles image payloads, please provide details, code snippets, or logs indicating a defect in the CLI code.
